title: CAP persistence and HANA
explain: CAP binds to persistence (often HANA); deploy design-time artifacts carefully. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "CAP persistence and HANA" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without CAP persistence and HANA, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of CAP persistence and HANA without a failure story
howToApply: Use CAP persistence and HANA explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “CAP persistence and HANA” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (CAP → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Discount approval near S/4 — choose placement using CAP persistence and HANA without core mods.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “CAP persistence and HANA” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “CAP persistence and HANA”.
